sources.title: DIVIPOLA—Códigos cabeceras / Centros poblados
sources.publisher: DANE, via Datos Abiertos Colombia / Socrata dataset xaxy-8nri
sources.restoration: Fetch API metadata and all rows; verify retained hashes. DANE describes CM as cabecera municipal, CP as centro poblado, ANM as área no municipalizada.

methods.administrative_join: Compare each source geoBoundaries shape ID with its indexed subject, then link to one unique DANE 2024 municipality by normalized department/name; four documented name variants use explicit within-department aliases and are individually flagged.
methods.settlement_assessment: Join every DANE centros poblados row by 5-digit DIVIPOLA municipality code; record CM/CP type counts for every subject. DANE center records do not imply all dispersed or unnamed habitation is inventoried.
methods.geometry_comparison: Reprojected current simplified subject geometry and pinned 2020 geoBoundaries geometry to EPSG:6933, compared area and symmetric-difference area with GDAL/OGR; invalid overlays retained as unresolved. No geometry changed.
methods.hierarchy: Follow each current parent ID through the published hierarchy to continent; cross-check municipality scope and assigned counts against DANE DIVIPOLA.
methods.uncertainty: No legal claims are derived from modern ownership/reference metadata. Area and boundary topology, regional limits and complete physical land/settlement inventory are not certified.
